title.zh: 增加首页课程订阅行动入口

purpose.en: Give visitors a clear call to action beside the free-first-month message and take them directly to the localized course subscription catalog.
purpose.zh: 在首月免费说明旁提供清晰行动按钮，并把访客直接带到当前界面的课程订阅目录。

en: Add an Action Now button to the Simple Subscription section on the English home page.
Add the matching 立即行动 button to the Chinese home page.
Route both buttons directly to the current locale's Choose Course and subscription catalog.
zh: 在英文首页的简单订阅区增加 Action Now 按钮。
在中文首页增加对应的“立即行动”按钮。
两个按钮都直接进入当前界面的选择课程与订阅目录。
响应式订阅行动按钮布局

en: Place the high-contrast action beside the subscription introduction on desktop and stack it safely on phone and iPad widths.
Add rendered-HTML coverage for the Chinese label and localized /zh/programs destination.
Teach the layout verifier to distinguish intentionally scrollable carousel items from page overflow and add missing home/trial measurement hooks.
zh: 桌面端将高对比行动按钮放在订阅介绍旁，手机与 iPad 宽度下安全换行。
增加运行时 HTML 测试，验证中文按钮及本地化 /zh/programs 目标。
让布局验证器区分横向滑块中可滚动的卡片与页面溢出，并补齐首页及匿名试学页测量钩子。

en: The production build and all 310 automated tests pass.
The WebKit runtime matrix passes 230/230 combinations across 23 routes, two interface languages, and five phone, iPad, and desktop viewports.
Shared policy, architecture, base-feature consistency, and SmartLingo contract gates pass.
zh: 生产构建及全部 310 项自动测试通过。
WebKit 运行时矩阵 230/230 全部通过，覆盖 23 条路由、两种界面语言及五种手机、iPad 和桌面视口。
共享规则、架构、基础功能一致性及 SmartLingo 合同门禁全部通过。

en: No subscription is started automatically; visitors still choose a language and course before confirming enrollment.
zh: 按钮不会自动开始订阅；访客仍需选择语言和课程后确认加入。

en: This call to action is SmartLingo-specific and does not change any other portfolio site.
zh: 本行动入口仅适用于 SmartLingo，不改变其他站点。
